dataset.window: 告警日 D 的窗口：截止 D+24h；24h 指 [D, D+24h)，48h 指 [D−24h, D+24h)。仅 ACH/Wire、排除自转账。

fan_in_24h.calc: 按币种分组，统计最近 24h 向该账户付款的不同账户数，取各币种最大值。
fan_in_24h.formula: MAX over currency( COUNT(DISTINCT from_bank:from_account) WHERE side=incoming AND t ≥ D )
fan_in_24h.description: Max distinct paying counterparties in one currency, last 24h

fan_in_48h.calc: 按币种分组，统计最近 48h 向该账户付款的不同账户数，取各币种最大值。
fan_in_48h.formula: MAX over currency( COUNT(DISTINCT from_bank:from_account) WHERE side=incoming )
fan_in_48h.description: Max distinct paying counterparties in one currency, last 48h

fan_out_24h.calc: 按币种分组，统计最近 24h 该账户付款给的不同账户数，取各币种最大值。
fan_out_24h.formula: MAX over currency( COUNT(DISTINCT to_bank:to_account) WHERE side=outgoing AND t ≥ D )
fan_out_24h.description: Max distinct receiving counterparties in one currency, last 24h

fan_out_48h.calc: 按币种分组，统计最近 48h 该账户付款给的不同账户数，取各币种最大值。
fan_out_48h.formula: MAX over currency( COUNT(DISTINCT to_bank:to_account) WHERE side=outgoing )
fan_out_48h.description: Max distinct receiving counterparties in one currency, last 48h

in_count_24h.calc: 最近 24h 该账户收到的付款笔数（所有币种合计）。
in_count_24h.formula: SUM( COUNT(*) WHERE side=incoming AND t ≥ D )

out_count_24h.calc: 最近 24h 该账户发出的付款笔数（所有币种合计）。
out_count_24h.formula: SUM( COUNT(*) WHERE side=outgoing AND t ≥ D )

in_banks_24h.calc: 按币种分组，最近 24h 向该账户付款的不同银行数，取最大值。
in_banks_24h.formula: MAX over currency( COUNT(DISTINCT from_bank) WHERE side=incoming AND t ≥ D )
in_banks_24h.description: Max distinct paying banks in one currency, last 24h

out_banks_24h.calc: 按币种分组，最近 24h 该账户付款去往的不同银行数，取最大值。
out_banks_24h.formula: MAX over currency( COUNT(DISTINCT to_bank) WHERE side=outgoing AND t ≥ D )
out_banks_24h.description: Max distinct receiving banks in one currency, last 24h

pass_through_ratio_24h.calc: 按币种计算最近 24h 汇出金额 / 汇入金额，上限 10，取各币种最大值；接近 1 表示收多少转多少。
pass_through_ratio_24h.formula: MAX over currency( LEAST(SUM(amount_paid out) / SUM(amount_received in), 10) )
pass_through_ratio_24h.description: Max over currencies of outgoing/incoming amount, capped at 10, last 24h

transit_gap_hours.zh: 收后转出最短间隔（小时）
transit_gap_hours.calc: 收到一笔款后到下一笔转出的最短时间：转出在最近 24h，转入在 48h 内，币种不限；没有这样的配对记为 49h。
transit_gap_hours.formula: MIN( (b.time − a.time)/3600 ) FROM in a JOIN out b ON b.payer = a.receiver AND a.time < b.time ≤ a.time + 48h
transit_gap_hours.description: Shortest gap from an incoming to a later outgoing payment (any currency), outgoing in last 24h, incoming within 48h; null if none

transit_pairs_24h.calc: 转入后 24h 内又转出的（转入, 转出）配对个数，转出在最近 24h。
transit_pairs_24h.formula: SUM( 1 WHERE gap ≤ 24h ) over receive→send pairs
transit_pairs_24h.description: Incoming-then-outgoing pairs within 24h, outgoing in last 24h

round_trip_48h.calc: 该账户转出给 48h 内曾经付款给它的账户的笔数（资金回流）。
round_trip_48h.description: Outgoing payments to an account that paid this account earlier within 48h

currency_count_24h.calc: 最近 24h 收付涉及的不同币种个数。
currency_count_24h.description: Distinct currencies across incoming and outgoing payments, last 24h

onward_currency_switch_48h.calc: 转出币种与之前 48h 内某笔转入币种不同的转出笔数（换汇后转出）。
onward_currency_switch_48h.description: Outgoing payments in a different currency from an earlier incoming payment within 48h

activity_change_24h.calc: 最近 24h 收付笔数 ÷（之前 24h 收付笔数 + 1），衡量相对自身历史的突增。
activity_change_24h.description: Payments in the last 24h divided by (payments in the prior 24h + 1)

new_counterparty_share_24h.calc: 最近 24h 的收付对手方中，过去 7 天从未与该账户交易过的比例。
new_counterparty_share_24h.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT cp WHERE (account, cp) ∉ prior 7d) / COUNT(DISTINCT cp)
new_counterparty_share_24h.description: Share of last-24h counterparties (either direction) with no transaction with this account in the prior 7 days

new_counterparties_24h.calc: 最近 24h 的收付对手方中，过去 7 天从未与该账户交易过的个数。
new_counterparties_24h.description: Last-24h counterparties with no transaction with this account in the prior 7 days

history_active_days_7d.calc: 告警日之前 7 天里有收付交易的天数；0 表示此前沉寂。
history_active_days_7d.description: Days with any payment in the prior 7 days (0 = dormant before today)

amount_vs_history_24h.calc: 按币种：最近 24h 最大一笔 ÷（过去 7 天同币种最大一笔 + 1），取各币种最大值，上限 1000。
amount_vs_history_24h.description: Max over currencies of the largest last-24h payment / (largest payment in the prior 7 days in that currency + 1), capped at 1000

P01.text: These indicators can inform your transaction monitoring alerts that trigger further review.
P01.zh: 异常、大额或复杂交易监测

P02.text: has an account that receives deposits from multiple third parties
P02.zh: 多个第三方向同一账户汇入

P03.text: makes rapid or complex funds transfers through multiple accounts
P03.zh: 资金快速经过多个账户

P04.text: has transactions that are inconsistent with their profile or transaction history
P04.zh: 交易与客户画像或历史不符

P05.text: makes frequent cash deposits or withdrawals over multiple days

P06.text: makes a large withdrawal following changes in their identification information, including email address or phone number
P06.zh: 身份信息变更后大额提现

P07.text: transfers funds to or from higher-risk jurisdictions

P08.text: splits large cash deposits into multiple smaller deposits below the $10,000 reporting threshold (known as structuring)
P08.zh: 拆分现金存款规避报告阈值

feature_proposals.analysis: The evidence table shows three flags with 100% laundering rates (currency_switch_on_chain, long_standing_counterparties, no_onward_movement, to_new_counterparty) versus a 56.5% base rate. Current features include onward_currency_switch_48h and new_counterparty_share_24h/new_counterparties_24h, but lack: (1) a tight-window measure of payments to brand-new counterparties immediately after receiving funds (onward_to_new_within_hours with hours=6 captures the critical 6-hour laundering window better

proposals.description: Outgoing payments to counterparties new to the account (no transaction in the prior 7 days) within H hours of an incoming payment
proposals.rationale: Launderers often move funds to fresh counterparties within hours of receipt; the 6-hour window isolates this burst better than the 24h/48h aggregates in current features. Evidence flag 'to_new_counterparty' had 100% laundering rate.

proposals.description: Payments received by this account's payees in the last 24h that leave in a different currency within H hours
proposals.rationale: Downstream currency switching by payees (currency_switch_on_chain, 100% laundering rate) is not captured by the account's own onward_currency_switch_48h. This feature watches the next hop.

proposals.description: Distinct paying accounts in the last 48h whose own sources were new to them in the prior 7 days
proposals.rationale: Converging new-source payers (sources_converging) detects coordinated layering where multiple upstream accounts simultaneously use fresh funding sources—a pattern invisible to fan_in counts alone.
